description.en: The ID of the connection address pool to query.
The instance ID of the cloud connector.
The IP address in the connection address pool.

description.zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值：**1**~**50**。默认值：**10**。
description.en: The number of entries to return per page during a paginated query. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Default Value: **10**.

description.zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
- 第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
- 如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值。
description.en:
Indicates whether a token for the next query exists. Valid values:
- Do not specify this parameter for the first query or when there is no subsequent query.
- If there is a subsequent query, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call.

description.zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The Region ID of the cloud connector instance.

You can invoke the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) API to obtain the Region ID.

description.zh:
连接地址池中IP地址类型。取值：

- **Cidr**：连接地址池所属的CIDR地址块。

- **Host**：物联网卡的IP地址。
description.en:
The type of IP address in the connection address pool. Valid values:

- **Cidr**: The CIDR block to which the connection address pool belongs.

- **Host**: The IP address of the Internet of Things SIM card.

title.zh: 查询连接地址池所有IP地址
title.en: Query all IP addresses in the connection address pool
